propositions: BindingStore module (799 lines) combines byte persistence, lifecycle policy, recovery, and rotation logic without clear ownership boundaries, creating safety and maintenance risks.
Production code mutates inner entries returned by shallow all_bindings() query, bypassing intended abstractions and risking silent data loss.

Interrupted retirements (durable tombstone with matching forward and reverse identities) must complete idempotently before remote issue fetch without automatic liveness signals overriding explicit unretire.
New recovery mechanism must run after staleness validation but before binding walk, differ, or lifecycle mutation to prevent interleaving upgraded liveness evidence with completion.

Extract repository/unit-of-work, lifecycle policy, and recovery as three internal owners behind one unchanged public facade while preserving all byte serialization, unknown fields, and exact JSON behavior.
Automatic liveness observations (absent_404_count, clear_absent, confirm) cannot revoke a durable tombstone; only explicit unretire removes completion intent.
